entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Triplett "Trip" O'Ferrall was a Virginia lawyer, judge and politician who fought as a cavalry officer in the Confederate States Army, then served as a U.S. representative from 1883 to 1894 and as the 42nd governor of Virginia from 1894 to 1898.
